description.value: August Jack Motor Inn is a motel on Squamish's main downtown strip, Cleveland Avenue, positioning itself as a base camp for Sea-to-Sky outdoor adventures including cycling, hiking, kitesurfing, and skiing. The property sits within walking distance of the town's restaurants, coffee shops, breweries, and civic amenities. It markets mountain or garden views, a fire pit, and BBQ facilities alongside its standard room offerings.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and provides good general content about the motel. It confirms high-speed Wi-Fi (corroborating OSM's internet_access=wlan tag), lists biking as one of the adventure activities guests pursue, and explicitly describes nearby restaurants and breweries on Cleveland Avenue. However, the website makes no mention of bike storage, laundry, e-bike charging, or other cycle-specific facilities, so those fields remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel in downtown Squamish with an active website and recent OSM check_date of 2026-04-24. Useful stop for touring cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website prominently lists BIKING as a featured adventure activity but provides no detail on any bike-specific facilities. A direct inquiry to the property would likely resolve the bike storage and related amenity fields.
